subject: Re: Kickoff: logit adjustment for long-tail classifiers — status
body:
Hi Dmitri, Jelena,

Status:

- Reproduction done Mar 18. On cifar10-lt (EXP-100 profile) the adjusted model beats the baseline by 4.1pp overall, and the win concentrates where it should: tail-class accuracy improves by double digits while head classes hold. cifar100-lt shows the same pattern. We sanity-checked with the release's dummy-dataset test mode before every real run, which caught one bad data path early.
- Farah's trainer flag merged Apr 10, ahead of schedule. Post-hoc adjustment mode included, so teams can fix already-trained models without retraining.

Risk for the pilot: the partner's label distribution is more extreme than EXP-100 (their tail classes have <20 examples), and the adjustment's gains shrink when frequency estimates get that noisy. I'm preparing a smoothed-frequency variant as a fallback. Partner dataset confirmation slipped a week to Apr 24 — Farah's May depth just got more important.

Carmen
